title: sysctl
description: A kernel parameter, set now and kept in /etc/sysctl.d/60-plumb-<name>.conf (D-260). Key: name. VM only: a container shares the host kernel. Risk: create and change disruptive (a kernel setting can cut the network); absent removes the file and keeps the running value (reversible).

value.description: Desired value. Runs of white space compare as one space. Required when state is present.
